predecessor.newMeasuredAntecedent: The governed incumbent completed inference and recorded provider release before a later native process abort, while Doe exited cleanly. The predecessor explicitly requires a new lifecycle hypothesis before this fact can receive credit.

hypothesis: Doe owns a repeatable application teardown outcome that cannot be reproduced above the pinned incumbent runtime: after exact Doppler inference, governed release, and immediate process teardown, Doe exits cleanly while both the unchanged governed incumbent and a bounded wrapper that waits for submitted work and destroys every observed device abort after release.

lanes.W0: Pinned node-webgpu through the unchanged governed provider contract.
lanes.P0: The same pinned node-webgpu behind a bounded wrapper that records requestDevice results, waits on each device queue, destroys every tracked device, then restores provider globals.
lanes.D0: DoeRuntime through the unchanged governed provider contract.

failureInjection.rule: Each process must complete the exact one-token application inference, persist the provisional inference receipt, execute its declared provider release path, persist release-complete evidence when possible, close the local model server, and terminate naturally without process.exit masking native destructors.

allowedChanges: intercept requestDevice only to retain returned device objects
call destroy on every retained device before governed release
forbiddenChanges: application, model, prompt, inference, shader, output, runtime, or sampling changes
process.exit, abort suppression, signal rewriting, or ignoring nonzero exit status

common: all lanes complete inference and produce identical generated text and token hashes
every process retains provider, module, source, model, trace, and terminal exit identity
no process times out and no software fallback is admitted
acceptance.antecedent: W0 must reproduce the post-release native abort in all three clean processes; otherwise the lifecycle property is not stable and the hypothesis retires.
acceptance.wrapperControl: If P0 exits zero in all three processes with explicit nonzero tracked-device cleanup, the governed wrapper closes the gap and DoeRuntime ownership is rejected.
acceptance.ownedRuntime: Only if W0 and P0 both reproduce the post-release abort in all three processes while D0 exits zero with release-complete evidence in all three does the lifecycle property authorize a larger ownership gate.
acceptance.mixedOutcome: Any other terminal pattern is diagnostic and retires this frozen realization without parameter or teardown-order tuning.

creditBoundary.onPass: Authorize a separately frozen repetition, bounded-memory-growth, concurrency, and device-loss ownership gate.
creditBoundary.onFail: Retain the lifecycle regression and do not reinterpret the terminal performance result.
